## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] JLP holders receive 75% of all fees from the JLP markets (opening and closing fees, price impact, borrow fees, swap fees); the other 25% goes to Jupiter as protocol revenue. JLP holders are the counterparty to every JLP-market trade, so trader profits are paid from the pool. Jupiter's Beta markets do not use the pool. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/earn/jlp · keywords: Max leverage and fee schedules · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps
- [statement] Liquidation penalties differ by venue. On Jupiter JLP markets a liquidated position forfeits all remaining collateral as the liquidation fee. On Jupiter Beta markets the fee is 0.75% (crypto) or 1% (stock) of position value and leftover collateral is returned, though in a fast market 'it can be little or nothing'. Velocity splits a per-market liquidation fee three ways between the liquidator, the insurance fund and the protocol. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/fees · keywords: Max leverage and fee schedules · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/liquidation, https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets, https://docs.velocity.exchange/trading/trading-fees

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] On Jupiter's JLP markets, a liquidated position forfeits all remaining collateral as the liquidation fee. On Beta markets, maintenance margin depends on a risk tier and leftover collateral is returned to the trader. The docs warn that borrow fees materially move the liquidation price above 10x, and that there is no margin call. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/liquidation · keywords: Max leverage and fee schedules · also: https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/positions-and-collateral.md
- [statement] Jupiter's Beta markets charge a maker fee of 0.005% (0.5 bps) on resting limit orders and a taker fee of 0.035% (3.5 bps) on market orders and on limit orders that fill at once. GUM's docs state the same rates and say the maker fee is a charge, not a rebate. A liquidation fee of 0.75% of position value applies on the crypto Beta markets and 1% on the stock markets. Beta markets have no base, price-impact or borrow fee; they pay hourly funding instead. The docs say the engine can adjust all of these rates. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-06) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets · keywords: Max leverage and fee schedules · also: https://docs.gum.ag/fees.md, https://docs.gum.ag/perps/overview.md
- [statement] Jupiter Beta markets charge a maker fee of 0.005% (0.5 bps) on resting limit orders, a taker fee of 0.035% (3.5 bps) on market orders and immediately executing limits, and a liquidation fee of 0.75% of position value on crypto markets (JUP, HYPE, ZEC) or 1% on stock markets. They have no base, price-impact or borrow fee; hourly funding replaces the borrow fee. The docs say the engine can adjust these rates. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-28) — https://docs.jup.ag/user-docs/trade/perps/beta-markets · keywords: Max leverage and fee schedules
